prompt: I'm pricing a Senior Systems Administrator role for NYC. The minimum wage I want to submit is $82/hour, and I'm targeting a 31% markup. Walk me through the bill rate calculation and decompose the markup into its cost components...

assertions.text: Correctly calculates NTE bill rate using HBR_NTE = HWR × (1 + M) formula
assertions.evidence: Output shows $82 × 1.31 = $107.42/hour, matching expected formula application

assertions.text: Decomposes 31% markup into all cost components with accurate allocation
assertions.evidence: Table shows payroll taxes ($11.07), insurance ($2.87), overhead ($8.61), OGS fee ($0.81), and net profit ($2.06) correctly calculated

assertions.text: Identifies profit margin and explains significance relative to market norms
assertions.evidence: Correctly identifies 1.92% net profit margin, flags it as below market (4-6%), and explains the gap

assertions.text: Provides actionable competitive assessment and strategic recommendations
assertions.evidence: Recommends options to improve margin, validates assumptions, and gives clear action items
